build_vqa2_ocr_dataset: build a VQA2 OCR dataset builder that registers the vqa2_ocr dataset with MMF registry
create_textvqa_builder: create a TextVQABuilder instance that sets the dataset name to VQA2_OCR and binds VQA2OCRDataset
review_TextVQABuilder_config_path: review the TextVQABuilder config_path classmethod that returns None instead of a YAML config path
refactor_TextVQABuilder_init: refactor the TextVQABuilder __init__ to customize the dataset name or dataset class assignment
summarize_VQA2OCRDataset: summarize the VQA2OCRDataset class that handles OCR token answers and formats predictions for VQA2
